key_provisions_or_claims: Data Privacy Act applies to personal data processing in AI development, training, testing and deployment.
Controllers must explain purpose, inputs, risks, outputs and dispute mechanisms of AI processing.
Controllers remain accountable for processors; must conduct PIAs, privacy-by-design, and consider AI ethics boards.
Meaningful human intervention and right to contest automated decisions with significant risk.
Bias monitoring, ban on AI washing, data minimization, and data subject rights (object, rectify, erase) preserved.
annotation.summary_en: Philippine National Privacy Commission advisory applying the Data Privacy Act 2012 to AI systems processing personal data. It sets expectations on transparency, accountability, governance mechanisms (PIAs, human intervention, ethics boards), fairness and bias monitoring, accuracy, data minimization, lawful basis, and data subject rights across AI training and deployment.
annotation.title_clean: NPC Advisory No. 2024-04: Guidelines on the Application of the Data Privacy Act of 2012 to Artificial Intelligence Systems Processing Personal Data
